name: Helen Keller International
mission: Guided by our founder’s remarkable legacy, Helen Keller Intl works to improve the lives of people around the world by protecting vision, enhancing nutrition, and fighting disease.
theoryOfChange: Helen Keller International has a published strategic framework titled 'Leading Locally, Fortifying Futures'. This strategy outlines their approach to sustaining core program areas of nutrition, vision, and health, and how they will drive transformation to achieve their vision of a world where every person can live a healthy life filled with potential. The document details strategic choices and initiatives, which are multi-year packages of activities designed to drive impact.
